text_block_list.text:
During training, Rhein Kraft got injured, 
so I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Sorry for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm glad it wasn't a major injury.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
With this, looks like I can walk right 
away... I think?
choice_data_list: For now, get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Okaaay.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Umm.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...If I just stay still, I feel like my 
spirits will sink...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Would it be okay... if I went for just a 
little walk?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I feel like injuries heal way faster if 
you get plenty of sunshine.
choice_data_list: You shouldn't push yourself too hard.
If that helps with your rehab...

text_block_list.text:
I persuaded her not to take her injury 
lightly, to rest quietly, and to save 
going for walks until she was fully 
healed.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose you're right. If you favor an 
injury while walking, it can make it 
worse, after all...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"For now, I'll take a good rest and focus 
on recovering..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, feels so good. Tan-ta-tan-ta-taan~♪

Setting off on a walk, Rhein Kraft soon 
began skipping along merrily.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, ow... I messed up...

Because Rhein Kraft's injury worsened, we 
decided to let her rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, walking around on it, it doesn't 
seem to hurt.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
With the power of the sun, I'm full of 
energy!

Basking in the blessing of the sun, Rhein 
Kraft made a splendid recovery from her 
injury.
